subject: Split textInput value into data frame

messages.author: 42ddcdae75316d70
messages.subject: Split textInput value into data frame
parts:
New Shiny user here.  

I wrote a script in R that takes a list of companies and does a web search on them and lets me know if it returns any results by returning a data frame with the company name and a 1 or a 0 if it finds anything.  

When I wrote the R script, I get the data into it by copying the company names from an excel sheet into the clipboard and using
read.table(file="clipboard", sep="\t")

I want to use this script in a shiny app, but instead of copying from excel, I want to allow the user to paste the list of companies into a text box.  However, if I use the input$text as the input, it puts all of the values into one long text string.  What's the best way to get the data into shiny?  I thought about importing an .xlsx using a file upload, but there may be issues with users not having the company list in the same location.

Thanks

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Split textInput value into data frame
parts:
The text input is for single-line text only. You need a textarea, e.g.

tags$textarea(id = 'foo')

Then you can use input$foo in server.R (e.g. read.table(text =
input$foo)). BTW, you should not rely on the clipboard in general --
when an app is deployed to a server, the server will not have access
to the client's clipboard.

Regards,
Yihui
